text_block_list.text:
One day at noon. Special Week was at
her favorite Western-style restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Spe-chan!
Here you go, some cold water!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No! ...Everyone seems busier than usual
today, did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, our shop got featured on TV!
So now we're super short on staff~."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so!
I see...—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Um!
Is there anything I can do to help?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Welcome!
Here's some cold water for you—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa! It's Cesario-san~!
Hello!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Spe-san?!
Why are you the one bringing the water...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Temporary reinforcement, reporting in!
It's unexpectedly bustling, so they seem short on hands.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
Spe-cha~n!
Sorry, but could you give us a hand in the kitchen?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, okaaaay!! Be right there!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
…………
Um, if you'd like, I can help too!

text_block_list.name: Head Chef
text_block_list.text:
Hey, the fried shrimp is already done!
Is the omurice set ready yet?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry! I'm making it right now!
—Uoooooh!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes, the gratin is ready~♪ Table five, please!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san! I'm free now, so should I make the next order—
the Salisbury steak?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, as expected of you, Cesario-san!
You work so fast!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'll be fine! Somehow...
Yes! I'll definitely manage somehow!”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
More importantly! The new girl was having trouble
taking orders, so please go help her out!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, understood.
Leave supporting her to me!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Spe-chan!
Even though the kitchen is so busy... thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! We're both busy, so don't worry about it!
More importantly, let's get through this rush together!

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~,
Lunch Set B, please!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Making it right now!
Ooooohhh! Guts, activate!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...So amazing...
Alright, I'll do it too...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well then, everyone, great work today!
Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Man, thank you so much, Special Week-san,
Cesario-san!
You really saved the day!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Things got a little chaotic,
but I had a lot of fun too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Besides... hehe! When I served the food,
I got to see so many smiling customers—

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Customer
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, little lady! Got a second?!
—That omurice was crazy delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh!? R-Really!?

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Customer
text_block_list.text:
Man, it's been ages since I had omurice that good!
Be sure to tell whoever made it that it was the best!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (Whoaa, beaming with such a big smile! To think she'd make a face like that...!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you so much!
Hearing you say that makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I was the one who made the omurice...!
Cooking can bring such big smiles
to everyone's faces, and that really sank in for me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "It was busy, but when I thought of the customers, it wasn't tough at all!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I totally understand that feeling!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I often make meals for my roommate too,
and she always eats them with such relish."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
When a dish turns out delicious, eating it yourself is great,
but having someone else eat it—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hearing someone say "that was delicious"
really warms your heart, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Cooking really is so rewarding!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Boiling, cutting, grilling... As expected, it takes quite a bit of effort.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: As tough as it was—seeing the customers smile made me reeeally happy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know! Next time, I'll try cooking back at the dorms!
And if that can make someone else happy tooâ
One weekday. It was lunchtime, and as I was thinking about what to eat—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I made a
boxed lunch! Would you like some?
choice_data_list: Huh, are you sure I can have this?
Huh, can I really have this?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! My cooking skills still have a long way to go, but I did my best!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "...H-How is it? I went through a lot of trial and error in my own way, or rather, I did a bunch of taste tests... umm..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Is it delicious?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes!!
...Ehehe, I kind of pressed you for it.
I just really wanted to hear you say that!
